units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 7:1">Shek. VII, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ למ׳</he> at an equal distance from each.

<cite ref="Chullin 29a:7">Ḥull. 29ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 79a:23">Pes. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ על מ׳ כרוב</he> half to half (if the nation is equally divided between clean and unclean), we treat it as if the majority were clean.
<cite ref="Chullin 28b:15">Ḥull. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ על מ׳ כרוב</he> half (of the vital organ) cut and half uncut is considered as if the larger portion were cut.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10:5">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>תשובה עושה מ׳</he> repentance effects half (the atonement); a. fr.
